games.name: UPDATE! Dynamic Ship Simulator III
games.desc:
Update 50 sets sail with something for everyone! Live it up aboard Superyacht Amaryllis, ride high seas on the Azerbaijan-class RO-PAX, or go back in time on the Julia Swain Paddlesteamer. Engage in player-vs-player combat in your Visby-class Corvette, cruise around in your motorboat or transport cars in your European-class ferry. Be sure to watch for updates!
